Fallback profile.role reads a column that does not exist in user_profiles, and the effective-role rescue called /auth/me expecting {data:{effective_role}} which /auth/me never returns (real endpoint is GET /staff/me/effective-role). getTabsForRole('authenticated') hits the default case = housekeeper tabs.
bugs.fix: Added toAppRole() normalizer in lib/supabase.ts (accepts only the 7 app roles, never 'authenticated'); _layout.tsx now decodes toAppRole(payload.user_role, payload.role) and fetches /staff/me/effective-role for schedule overrides. bugs.error_message: HTTP 422 on mobile when reporting late checkout for a departure room
bugs.root_cause: Two issues: (1) late_checkout_requests table was never applied to Supabase (migration was untracked/uncommitted). (2) CreateLateCheckoutRequest.room_id used UUID4 (strict version-4 check) — Pydantic v2.9.2's wildcard mode=before sanitizer processes the string before UUID4 validation, which can reject valid UUIDs if the version nibble isn't read correctly after sanitization.
bugs.fix: Applied migration 061 via Supabase MCP to create late_checkout_requests table. Changed room_id field from UUID4 to UUID (stdlib) in CreateLateCheckoutRequest — FK integrity is enforced by the DB, not Pydantic version strictness.

bugs.error_message: PICKUP room shows no 'Guest may be inside' warning in Before You Enter section
bugs.root_cause: isGuestMayBeInside() checked for status===OCCUPIED, fo_status===OCC, and guest_name+DEP — but never for status===PICKUP. Stayover/pickup rooms don't have fo_status set to OCC in all cases, so the warning silently never appeared.
bugs.fix: Added `room.status === "PICKUP"` as a condition in isGuestMayBeInside() so the warning always fires for pickup rooms before cleaning starts.
